text: Cycling, a mode of transportation that has been an integral part of human culture for centuries, is a fun and adventurous sport that allows riders to explore new paths and enjoy the scenic beauty of the outdoors. To navigate the bike, riders turn the pedals, which engages the rear gear, propelling the bike forward. The rear cog is typically fixed to the pedal, making it easier to change gears. Wearing a helmet protects the head from impacts, while a leather cover provides comfort and style.
